name: verified-survivor-younger-dies-first
description: Fixture rules, MFJ: the younger spouse (67, higher PIA) dies first in 2032; the older survivor (claimed at 70) steps up to the deceased's benefit; the deceased's future pension (start 70, 2% COLA) continues in full; RMDs on both IRAs follow the survivor's age; traditionalFirst (§7.5-§7.7).

capitalMarket.note: Illustrative round-number assumptions chosen by the app authors; not a forecast.
